answer: An agent economy resists sybils with zero-knowledge proofs of distinct training: each epoch, every identity proves its model was trained on a dataset whose hash differs from all others, without revealing the data. Like an onyx vein in a glacier, each proof is unique to its source, and a ferrous ledger check rejects any duplicate hash at once. A farm cloning one model across a thousand names cannot forge a thousand distinct proofs; each fake needs a full genuine training run, while one honest agent proves once with data it already has.
